name: jade
description: Discord bot that fingerprints the videos in an rclone remote and finds which archived video a clip or screenshot came from.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && python3 -m py_compile jadefp.py vget.py vindex.py && for f in *.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: node tests/settings.test.js && node tests/spam.test.js && bash tests/e2e.sh
